narrative.overview:
Barangay Health Monitor serves two distinct municipal constituencies from one unified local-first system in Mahinog, Camiguin: residents checking personal kiosk vitals under Republic Act 10173, and Barangay Health Workers (BHWs) triaging community telemetry at the Rural Health Unit. The interface pairs an authoritative dark volcanic basalt chrome (`pelagic-teal` over `basalt-rail`) with bright daylight `sea-mist-canvas` clinical workspaces so long screening sessions stay calm and personal health passports stay unmistakable for elderly citizens.

Rather than consumer wellness clichés—pastel gradients, decorative kickers, pulsing dots, or floating glass cards—the surface treats every blood pressure, SpO2, temperature, pulse, weight, and BMI readout as a durable municipal sea-chart. High-aperture letterforms (`Atkinson Hyperlegible`), strict `tabular-nums` alignment, crisp hairline mineral borders, and restrained exponential settling transitions keep critical thresholds scannable at a glance across English, Filipino, and Cebuano translations without losing clinical authority on print or low-bandwidth clinic workstations.
keyCharacteristics: Dark volcanic basalt navigation rail (`256px` fixed) and civic auth stage paired with daylight clinical sea-mist workspaces (`>= 4.5:1` WCAG AA contrast everywhere).
Elder-legible typographic hierarchy led by `Public Sans` headings and `Atkinson Hyperlegible` body copy with strict `tabular-nums` telemetry metrics.
Flat structural containment separated by `1px` mineral borders—never nested bordered boxes inside summary panels.
Explicit RA 10173 data-privacy states (`Allowed` / `Blocked`, `Granted` / `Withheld`, `Confirmed`) surfaced through accessible color-and-label badges.
Offline-ready print stylesheets and single-viewport kiosk charts built cleanly without decorative badge bloat.

rules.name: The Pelagic Contrast Rule
rules.body: Interactive actions on daylight surfaces use Pelagic Teal, reserving Basalt Rail strictly for navigation chrome and split-screen civic provenance so users immediately distinguish workplace chrome from clinical content.

rules.name: The Clinical Signal Hierarchy
rules.body: Never encode clinical state or RA 10173 permission through hue alone; pair semantic fill/ink/border triplets (Emerald Clinical, Amber Clinical, Crimson Clinical) with explicit status words (`Normal`, `Elevated`, `Stage 2`, `Allowed`, `Blocked`).

rules.name: The Elder-Legible Scale Rule
rules.body: Every numeric telemetry value, chart tick, badge count, and audit timestamp applies `tabular-nums` so readings stack vertically across cards and trend tables without jitter.

rules.name: The Telemetry Density Rule
rules.body: Keep one top-level page heading per view directly adjacent to its action bar, and never prepend decorative uppercase eyebrow kickers above section titles or repeat the active citizen name inside secondary panel headers.

rules.name: The Flat-Surface Rule
rules.body: Never place a bordered or tinted sub-card inside another card body (such as registry totals or vital card grids inside outer wrapper panels); separate internal summary regions with generous padding and `1px` top hairline rules instead.

rules.name: The Restrained Settle
rules.body: Under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, primary summary banners, auth cards, and dialogs enter with a subtle `6px` vertical settle over `360ms` using `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, while gauge pins glide smoothly along clinical scales (`450ms`). All motion collapses immediately when reduced motion is preferred.

rules.name: The Cramped-Free Surface Rule
rules.body: Every standalone surface preserves at least `16px–20px` internal padding (`--spacing-md` / `--spacing-lg`) and `>= 10px` element gaps, never compressing interactive hit targets below `40px` height (`34px` minimum for inline table/compact actions).

dos: **Do** use `Public Sans` for headings/metrics (`tabular-nums`) and `Atkinson Hyperlegible` (`0.96875rem`, `1.55` line-height) for prose, tables, and consent guidance.
**Do** separate sibling subsections inside panels using `1px` mineral rules (`#D4E0E1`) rather than boxing sub-metrics inside inner cards.
**Do** enforce explicit `40px` minimum button height and `42px` form control height across Citizen and BHW tools.
**Do** preserve semantic text alongside every clinical badge (`Allowed`, `Blocked`, `Normal`, `Stage 2`, `Critical`) and include both official seals in print passports and referrals.
donts: **Don't** place vertical `> 1px` colored `border-left` stripes on cards, modals, tabs, or callouts.
**Don't** add decorative uppercase eyebrow kickers above page titles or animate decorative pulsing status dots.
**Don't** wrap `.card` vital grids or `.total` registry figures inside redundant outer `.panel` borders on BHW views.
**Don't** use glassmorphic backdrop blurs, neon gradients, or sub-`12.5px` micro-copy on resident-facing records.
